# UpdatePersistedSpecImplementation

Canonical-spec counterpart of change-time implementation tracking; mutates canonical persisted lock state only.

## Rules

- `execute` input `UpdatePersistedSpecImplementationInput`: specId (required), action (required, add|remove), file (required, project-relative to specId workspace codeRoot), symbols? (readonly string[], symbol refinements).
- Add requires target file exist on disk under specId workspace codeRoot; else throw ImplementationFileNotFoundError, no mutation.
- Before mutation normalize file → canonical workspace:path identity per core:spec-lock: forward-slash normalized, relative to specId workspace codeRoot, using core:workspace lookup + core:storage path resolution. Out-of-codeRoot resolution → ImplementationWorkspaceBoundaryError; never silently coerce/drop out-of-boundary path.
- Add creates or enriches confirmed link for normalized file identity. With symbols: add to link symbol set without discarding previously recorded symbols for that file. Without symbols: ensure file-level entry exists (no `symbols` field) without altering existing symbol-level entries.
- Remove with symbols: remove only those symbol names from link symbol set; MAY drop entry entirely when remaining set empty and no separate explicit file-level link recorded. Remove without symbols: remove whole implementation entry incl. symbol-level refinements.
- Add against missing persisted state: resolve initial base via same resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn() service used by core:initialize-persisted-spec-state, implementation defaults [], then apply addition.
- Remove against missing state: no-op — MUST NOT create persisted state; return result with implementation [] and created false, never call writePersistedState.
- Apply mutation through shared pure applyPersistedSpecStatePatch(): compute resulting implementation array as patch, pass complete resulting PersistedSpecState to SpecRepository.writePersistedState() with expectedRevision = observed originalHash (null when state was absent).
- Repository revision mismatch at write time → propagate ArtifactConflictError; never retry or silently rebase.
- Spec identity unresolvable to existing spec artifact set in its workspace → throw SpecNotFoundError.
- Success returns UpdatePersistedSpecImplementationResult: specId (fully-qualified), implementation (resulting link list), created (true only when state newly created by this call).
- Config factory createUpdatePersistedSpecImplementation(config, options?) derives deps via resolveUpdatePersistedSpecImplementationDeps(resolver) then delegates to canonical createUpdatePersistedSpecImplementation(deps). Resolver provides: specs ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository> (one per workspace), workspaces config lookup (codeRoot resolution), files FileReader (existence checks), initializePersistedSpecState collaborator (for resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn on add creation path). Helper is the only use-case-specific composition entry; factory MUST NOT reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.

## Constraints

- Never mutates change draft trackedImplementationFiles or in-progress confirmed links — canonical persisted lock state only
- readOnly workspace ownership rejects write with ReadOnlyWorkspaceError before any persisted-state I/O
- Normalization + symbol-refinement rules mirror change tracking but always operate/store canonical workspace:path identity, never raw project-relative paths in storage
